caption: The video captures a coastal beach scene at low sun, where the bright disc sits just above the horizon left of center and throws a vertical glittering column across the water. A dark, vegetated headland fills the right side, topped by a pale multi-story house, while layered grey clouds spread overhead and a damp pebbly shore slopes to the waterline. The overall framing of sun, cliff, house and horizon holds steady throughout, with the camera essentially static. A small low wave translates shoreward over the excerpt, gradually gathering a thin white foam crest. This crest advances diagonally onto the wet sand at the lower left, spreading as it runs up the beach. Meanwhile the sun's reflection shimmers, breaking into shifting bright and dark ripple segments that keep their horizontal position. The right-side waterline foam and the cliff silhouette remain essentially unchanged in place. The wave continues its slow approach as the clip runs.
